create_embeddings_for_implicit_function: create embeddings for 3D implicit function rendering from world coordinates with optional viewpooling and global code
interpolate_volume: interpolate 3D volume grid values at arbitrary points using trilinear interpolation via grid_sample
interpolate_plane: bilinearly interpolate 2D plane grid values at arbitrary points using grid_sample
interpolate_line: linearly interpolate 1D line grid values at arbitrary points using grid_sample
broadcast_global_code: broadcast and concatenate a global code tensor to the last dimension of embedding tensors
